description: Poll a logo job by its jobToken. Once payment has settled, returns a URL to download the full-resolution, watermark-free asset; otherwise a pending status. Read-only and safe to poll — after the user pays, keep polling every ~5 seconds for up to a few minutes (payment confirmation is not instant) until the status is paid.
name: get_logo_result

assetUrl.description: Download URL for the deliverable; present once paid.

brandName.description: Brand name on the deliverable; present once paid.

emailNote.description: Note about the emailed download link; present once paid.

includes.description: What the deliverable bundle includes; present once paid.

note.description: Human-readable guidance for the current state.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Seconds to wait before polling again, when not yet ready.

status.description: Job state. Only `paid` carries a downloadable asset.

tier.description: Purchased delivery tier; present once paid or processing.

title: Get logo result
